d: 9/11 ke bad cockpit ka darvaza islie mazbut bana tha ki aatanki bahar rahen... par 30 sitanbar 2026 ko Dubai se Tel Aviv ja rahi Flydubai ki flight FZ1073 men khatra usi darvaze ke andar baitha tha. Oman ke co-pilot ne bhartiy Captain smit machchhar par chaku se var kie aur viman tezi se hazaron phit niche girne laga. 39 sal ke smit ne khun se lathpath hokar bhi darvaza kaise khola? Yaniv Hayoun ne aatanki ko khinchkar kaise nikala, aur yatriyon ne use headphone ke taron se kaise bandha? PM modi, Trump aur Israel ne is bhartiy pilot ko hero kyon kaha? 1986 men nirja bhanot ne Pan Am 73 men…
